{{Top|leg}}
'''Tingler shells''' were the ammunition used in [[Aeramaxis Technologies]]' [[PDW-50 Ionic Tingler]]. Once loaded in the weapon, each shell was charged by an [[ionic pulse regulator]] to energize the [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] inside. The shell could be fully charged in ten [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]], but a partial charge could take as little as two minutes. Upon contact with the target, the shell burst open, scattering the plasma particles which reacted with the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], causing a localized blast.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
